ECHOES_IN_MOTION.description: Ribbon tunnel with smooth rotational motion; excellent for tech trance grooves and drops.
ECHOES_IN_MOTION.notes: Good all-rounder. Current defaults based on Voltage Temple in Vol 11.

ENTROPY_COLLAPSE.description: Fragmenting core and shards with star field; great for heavier tech peaks.
ENTROPY_COLLAPSE.notes: Defaults based on Subharmonic Core in Vol 11.

GRAVITON_FLUX.description: Bands and caustics bending under gravity-like shear.
GRAVITON_FLUX.notes: Defaults based on Chrome Horizon in Vol 11.

JULIA_GRID.description: Audio-reactive fractal grid; sharp and hypnotic when driven moderately.
JULIA_GRID.notes: Defaults based on Spectral Pressure in Vol 11. Keep audio_gain below ~0.5 in features-driven mode.

LISSAJOUS_GLOVES.description: Fast, vector-like trails reminiscent of light show gloves; strong tech-trance identity.
LISSAJOUS_GLOVES.notes: Used on Torque Vector in Vol 11; color and swirl tuned for legibility.

SHADER_TOBER.description: Complex audio-reactive field; can be busy but good for certain peaks.
SHADER_TOBER.notes: Defaults based on Echo Chamber in Vol 11. Keep audio_gain in a tight window.

SMITH_CELLS.description: Grid of pulsing cells; reacts nicely to kick and synth stabs.
SMITH_CELLS.notes: Defaults based on Phase Containment in Vol 11.

SONIC_FUSION.description: Striped / banded visual responsive to spectrum; strong rhythmic feel.
SONIC_FUSION.notes: Defaults based on Reactor Lines in Vol 11.

SPARKLE_AND_LINES.description: Sparkling particles over rhythm lines; good mid-set energy shader.
SPARKLE_AND_LINES.notes: Used on Circuit Prayer in Vol 11.

SPIRAL_RIBBON_TUNNEL.description: Spiral tunnel with banded motion, good for driving grooves and drops.
SPIRAL_RIBBON_TUNNEL.notes: Used on Iron Residue in Vol 11. Limited levers but visually strong.

SPIRAL_RUNNER.description: Radial spiral arms that thicken and brighten with energy.
SPIRAL_RUNNER.notes: Defaults based on Neural Flux in Vol 11.

TRIPLE_WAVE_LINES.description: Three stacked waveforms with controllable colors; excellent closing shader.
TRIPLE_WAVE_LINES.notes: Defaults based on Last Frequency in Vol 11.

hexagone.description: Audio-reactive hex lattice; can look amazing but very sensitive to drive.
hexagone.notes: Defaults based on Grain Density in Vol 11. audio_drive must stay ~0.02–0.03.

power_particle.notes: Rebuilt presets from shader defaults, low audio drive, capped level_drive <= 0.075.

line.description: Pastel spectrum+waveform lines; gentle deep progressive visual.
